caption:
Don't know the word? Don't cut it.

Cross out the choices you KNOW clash with the clue first. Here, cooperative, apologetic, and uncertain all fail, so intransigent wins even if it's new to you.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: Unknown word in the choices? Don't cross it out first.

youtube.title: SAT Vocab: Don't Cross Out Words You Don't Know
youtube.description: Eliminate the words you know don't fit; an unfamiliar survivor is often right. SAT-style practice question (original).
